name: gpu_capacity_acceptance
description: Checks whether buyer-observed GPU names, count, timestamp, and MIG-mode field were consistent with a declared GPU capacity snapshot.

claim.text: The observed GPU names, count, timestamp, and MIG-mode field were consistent with the declared GPU capacity snapshot.

gpu_inventory.declared_sku.probe: record declared GPU SKU from provider reservation/order evidence
gpu_inventory.declared_sku.why: Without the declared SKU, observed GPU names cannot be compared to what the buyer meant to accept.

gpu_inventory.declared_count.probe: record declared GPU count from provider reservation/order evidence
gpu_inventory.declared_count.why: Without the declared count, observed GPU count cannot be compared to the reservation or order.

gpu_probe_observation.observed_names.probe: run nvidia-smi acceptance capture and import observed GPU names
gpu_probe_observation.observed_names.why: Without observed GPU names, the compiler cannot compare delivered GPU family or variant to the declaration.

gpu_probe_observation.observed_count.probe: run nvidia-smi acceptance capture and import observed GPU count
gpu_probe_observation.observed_count.why: Without observed GPU count, the compiler cannot decide whether the declared quantity was visible.

gpu_probe_observation.observed_mig_modes.probe: capture nvidia-smi MIG mode and nvidia-smi -L output
gpu_probe_observation.observed_mig_modes.why: Without MIG-mode evidence, the compiler cannot fail closed on ambiguous dedicated-capacity visibility.

gpu_probe_observation.observed_at.probe: capture nvidia-smi timestamp for the acceptance snapshot
gpu_probe_observation.observed_at.why: Without an observation timestamp, the compiler cannot bind the GPU snapshot to a point in time.
